result:
The proposed argument does not establish the count. It asserts that AP holds for "exactly eight" quasivarieties, but it never identifies them or proves which ones have AP. The parity and chain-embeddability remarks are general, and the appeal to "systematic analysis" is not a derivation. I also cannot verify the number from memory of the literature on quasivarieties of Sugihara algebras, so I cannot confirm 8 is right either.

VERDICT: REJECT

CONFIDENCE: 2
